# Semantic-Anchor Checkpoints with Suffix-Only Re-Prefill

## 1. Mechanism

**Coordinates.** Every context block lives at a meta-coordinate in the memlang layer:

```
coord := (stream_id, epoch, ordinal, span)
canonical form: @ctx/main@e3.o41[1024:1536]
```

Within an epoch, `ordinal` is append-only. Any structural rewrite bumps `epoch`; old epochs become read-only. This is what makes "immutable prefix" expressible as a coordinate comparison instead of a content diff.

**Anchor object.**

```
Anchor {
  anchor_id:    uuid7
  coord:        Coord              # seals everything strictly before coord.span.end
  cum_hash:     bytes32            # H_i = BLAKE3(H_{i-1} || canon(meta_tokens[i-1:i]))
  parent_id:    anchor_id | None
  state:        DRAFT | SEALED | INVALIDATED
  kv_pages:     [page_id]          # pinned KV covering [0, coord.span.end)
  abs_pos_end:  int64              # absolute model position at boundary (RoPE continuation)
}
```

DRAFT→SEALED on provenance-finality events (turn close, tool-result commit, summary accept). SEALED ⇒ immutable within its epoch, forever. Verification cost is O(anchors-since-seal), not O(tokens), because the chain is cumulative.

**Prefill protocol being enforced:** resolve edit target → verify chain from last sealed anchor to head → pin anchor's KV pages → run prefill over `[anchor.abs_pos_end, new_tail_end)` only, with RoPE offset = `abs_pos_end` → emit DRAFT anchor at new tail → commit. Prefix KV is loaded, never recomputed.

## 2. memlang surface

```
SEAL       := "SEAL" "ANCHOR" "AT" COORD "END"
SPLICE     := "SPLICE" COORD "<-" src ("FROM" "ANCHOR" aid)?
APPEND     := "APPEND" payload "TO" stream ("FROM" "ANCHOR" aid)?
TRUNCATE   := "TRUNCATE" stream "AFTER" COORD
COMPACT    := "COMPACT" stream "INTO" src "VIA" "FORK"
RESUME     := "RESUME" stream "FROM" "ANCHOR" aid
FORK       := "FORK" "EPOCH" stream "FROM" "ANCHOR" aid
INVALIDATE := "INVALIDATE" "ANCHOR" aid            ; DRAFT-only except via tier-0 path
```

Mutating ops default `FROM ANCHOR` to the last sealed anchor; an explicit clause may only name an anchor at or above the last sealed ordinal. Missing/illegal clause is a parse error (`E.ANCHOR_REQUIRED`), not a runtime surprise.

## 3. Registry integration — `mag/law.py`

Tier semantics used below: **T0** inviolable/safety · **T1** correctness-critical, blocking · **T2** liveness/perf · **T3** advisory.

```python
# mag/law.py
from mag.lawkit import Law, Trigger, Predicate, Effect, Tier, register

@register
LAW_CTX_ANCHOR_SUFFIX_PREFILL = Law(
    id="LAW.CTX.ANCHOR.SUFFIX_PREFILL",

    trigger=Trigger(
        event="memlang.op.commit",
        match={"op": {"SPLICE", "APPEND", "TRUNCATE", "COMPACT"}},
        phase="pre_commit",                    # veto window; post-commit is too late
        source="memlang.interpreter",
    ),

    condition=Predicate(
        expr="""
          op.target.stream == ctx.stream
          AND op.target.epoch == ctx.head.epoch
          AND op.target.ordinal >= ctx.last_sealed_anchor.ordinal
          AND verify_hash_chain(ctx.last_sealed_anchor, ctx.head)
          AND kv_pool.refcount(ctx.last_sealed_anchor.kv_pages) > 0
        """,
        bindings={
            "verify_hash_chain": "mag.ctx.anchors.verify_chain",   # BLAKE3, O(anchors)
        },
    ),

    action=[
        Effect("kv_pool.pin",    anchor="ctx.last_sealed_anchor", ttl="until_epoch_close"),
        Effect("prefill.run",    start="ctx.last_sealed_anchor.abs_pos_end",
                                 end="op.new_tail.abs_pos_end",
                                 rope_offset="ctx.last_sealed_anchor.abs_pos_end",
                                 budget="cfg.prefill.max_tokens_per_step"),
        Effect("anchor.emit",    at="op.new_tail", state="DRAFT"),
        Effect("journal.append", record="edit.suffix_prefill",
                                 carries=["anchor_id", "cum_hash_before", "cum_hash_after",
                                          "token_delta"]),
        Effect("op.commit"),
    ],

    guardrail=(
        "G1: no write touches meta-token ordinal < ctx.last_sealed_anchor.ordinal; "
        "violation => veto op, emit ctx.integrity.violation. Legal continuation is "
        "'FORK EPOCH', never in-place mutation.",

        "G2: hash-chain mismatch at any link => veto, zero partial KV writes "
        "(all-or-nothing per op); dispatch LAW.CTX.RECOVER.FULL_RECOMPUTE.",

        "G3: pinned pages are eviction-immune; allocator OOM under pin => fail the op "
        "clean, never evict a pin.",

        "G4: prefill budget overrun => chunk at meta-token boundaries across steps; "
        "each chunk journals its resume coord; never truncate a span silently.",

        "G5: every committed edit leaves >=1 SEALED anchor behind it; an epoch closing "
        "with zero sealed anchors is a corruption event (tier-0 alert).",
    ),

    tier=Tier.T1,
)
```

Two companion records are required for this law to be able to fire; register them alongside:

```python
@register
LAW_CTX_ANCHOR_SEAL_EMISSION = Law(
    id="LAW.CTX.ANCHOR.SEAL_EMISSION",
    trigger=Trigger(event={"ctx.turn.close", "tool.result.commit", "summary.accept"},
                    phase="post_apply"),
    condition=Predicate(expr="head.gap_since_last_anchor > cfg.anchor.max_gap_tokens"),  # default 2048
    action=[Effect("anchor.emit", at="ctx.head", state="SEALED"),
            Effect("kv_pool.pin", anchor="ctx.head_anchor", ttl="until_epoch_close")],
    guardrail=("seal refuses if recomputed chain value != candidate.cum_hash",),
    tier=Tier.T1,
)

@register
LAW_MEM_KV_PIN_IMMUNITY = Law(
    id="LAW.MEM.KV.PIN_IMMUNITY",
    trigger=Trigger(event="kv_pool.evict.candidate", phase="pre_evict"),
    condition=Predicate(expr="candidate.page_id ∈ ⋃{a.kv_pages : a.state == SEALED}"),
    action=[Effect("evict.skip"), Effect("metric.bump", key="kv.evict.pin_skipped")],
    guardrail=("under pool pressure, shed DRAFT anchors LRU-by-draft-age first; "
               "a pinned page is never evicted",),
    tier=Tier.T0,   # evicting a pinned page corrupts attention over sealed history with NO error signal
)
```

## 4. Runtime decision table

| Case | Outcome |
|---|---|
| Target ordinal ≥ seal ordinal, chain verifies, pages pinned | Suffix prefill, commit (happy path) |
| Chain mismatch anywhere | Veto `E.VETO[LAW.CTX.ANCHOR.SUFFIX_PREFILL:G2]` → full-recompute recovery |
| Target ordinal < seal ordinal | Veto `:G1`; only legal continuation is `FORK EPOCH FROM ANCHOR …` (child inherits `abs_pos` contiguously, so cross-epoch caches stay valid) |
| `COMPACT` | Desugars to `FORK` + splice at new epoch head; sealed bytes never touched |
| `TRUNCATE` after seal | Invalidate trailing DRAFT anchors, unpin, commit; before seal → fork path |
| Fresh stream, no anchor | Implicit anchor at ordinal 0; one full prefill, then normal path |
| Pin pressure / OOM | Op fails clean, no partial KV; DRAFT anchors shed first |

## 5. Acceptance invariants (CI property tests)

- **I1:** `replay(journal)` reproduces every sealed `cum_hash` bit-for-bit.
- **I2:** For every committed op, bytes at ordinals `< seal.ordinal` are identical pre/post (byte-diff harness).
- **I3:** `tokens_prefilled ≤ tokens_appended + Σ recompute_windows`, each window ≤ `cfg.anchor.max_gap_tokens`.
- **I4:** Crash at any prefill chunk → resume from journaled chunk coord yields byte-identical final KV (deterministic prefill).

The one-line rationale for the whole design: the anchor's cumulative hash converts "is my cached prefix still the context?" from an O(n) token comparison into an O(k) chain walk, and the law converts that check from a convention into a veto gate sitting at `pre_commit`, where a violation costs nothing.

### Design

**Semantic anchors**: Positions in the meta-token stream that are declared immutable once written. They're emitted at:
- tool-call result boundaries
- user-turn boundaries
- compaction summary insertions
- explicit `ANCHOR` directives in memlang

Each anchor has:
- `anchor_id`
- `meta_coord`: address in the meta-token layer, e.g., `(stream_id, epoch, offset)`
- `kv_prefix_hash`: hash of the serialized prefix up to and including the anchor
- `ref_count` / dependencies

**Re-prefill only the suffix**: When an edit occurs (insertion, replacement, compaction), the runtime finds the deepest anchor whose prefix-hash still matches the current logical context; everything before it is served from cached KV; everything after is recomputed. If no anchor matches, fall back to full recompute (or nearest shallower anchor).

**Hard parts:**

1. **Anchor placement policy**: Where do you place anchors? Too many → cache fragmentation, too few → large recompute windows. Answer: anchor at natural immutability boundaries (sealed turns, tool results that are content-addressed). Anchor density heuristic: target max recompute window W (e.g., 2048 meta-tokens); if gap between consecutive anchors > W, insert synthetic anchor.

2. **Hash chain integrity**: Each anchor stores cumulative hash H_i = H(H_{i-1} || tokens(i-1..i)). Edit validity check = walk back from head until H matches. This gives O(k) verification where k = number of invalidated anchors, not O(n) tokens.

3. **Suffix-only prefill correctness**: Attention requires the suffix's queries attend to prefix KVs. So "re-prefill only the suffix" means: load pinned prefix KV pages (zero recompute), run prefill on suffix tokens only, with positional offsets continuing from anchor's absolute position. Must handle RoPE position ids correctly — positions are absolute in the meta-token coordinate space, mapped to model positions via a deterministic function.

4. **Edit semantics vs anchors**: An edit targeting before the last sealed anchor violates the law → must trigger either (a) rejection, (b) copy-on-write fork creating a new branch/epoch, or (c) escalation to higher-tier law allowing controlled invalidation. The guardrail should forbid silent mutation.

5. **Concurrency**: multiple edits in flight; anchors are single-writer; use epoch fencing.

6. **Failure modes**: KV cache eviction under memory pressure → pinning must be respected by the allocator; if pinned pages evicted anyway (OOM), degrade to next-shallower anchor, log, and mark degraded.

7. **Tier semantics**: tiers presumably T0..T3 or similar. This one should be high tier because violating it corrupts the context silently — worse than crashing. Guardrails are non-negotiable invariants; conditions are checkable predicates; actions are the enforced behavior.

### Mechanism

**Coordinate layer.** Every context block lives at a meta-coordinate:

```
coord := (stream_id, epoch, ordinal, span)
```

- `stream_id`: logical context (e.g., `"agent.main"`).
- `epoch`: increments on any structural rewrite (branch/fork/compaction-with-rewrite).
- `ordinal`: monotonically increasing slot within epoch; append-only within an epoch.
- `span`: `[start_meta_token, end_meta_token)` half-open.

Canonical textual form used by memlang: `@ctx/main@e3.o41[1024:1536]`.

**Semantic anchor.**

```
Anchor {
  anchor_id:     uuid7
  coord:         Coord          # end-boundary it seals: everything < coord.end is frozen
  cum_hash:      bytes32        # H_i = BLAKE3(H_{i-1} || canonical_bytes(meta_tokens[i-1:i]))
  parent_id:     anchor_id|None
  state:         DRAFT | SEALED | INVALIDATED
  kv_pages:      list[page_id]  # pinned KV pages covering [0, coord.end)
  abs_pos_end:   int64          # absolute model position at boundary (for RoPE continuation)
}
```

Seal rule: an anchor transitions DRAFT→SEALED when its span's provenance is final (tool result committed, turn closed, summary accepted). Sealed ⇒ immutable forever within its epoch.

**Edit + prefill protocol (the thing the law enforces):**

On `EDIT`/append/compaction commit:
1. Resolve target coord. If `target.ordinal >= last_sealed_anchor.ordinal` → suffix-edit path.
2. Verify `cum_hash` chain from last sealed anchor to head (O(#anchors since seal), not O(tokens)).
3. Pin `kv_pages` of the anchor (allocator refcount++, eviction-exempt).
4. Recompute prefill over `[anchor.abs_pos_end, new_tail_end)` only, with RoPE base offset = `anchor.abs_pos_end`.
5. Emit new DRAFT anchor at new tail; promote to SEALED on next seal event.
6. On hash mismatch at step 2 → veto, no partial writes, route to full-recompute recovery path.

**memlang surface:**

```
SEAL   ANCHOR AT @ctx/main@e3.o41 END      ; freeze prefix through o41
SPLICE @ctx/main@e3.o44[...] <- @scratch/sum.v7   ; legal: o44 > last sealed ordinal
SPLICE @ctx/main@e3.o39[...] <- ...               ; illegal: below seal → vetoed by law
RESUME FROM ANCHOR a_8f2c                          ; prefill entrypoint declaration
INVALIDATE ANCHOR a_8f2c CASCADE                   ; only via escalated tier-0 path
```

Grammar-level constraint encoded in interpreter: any opcode that mutates coords takes a mandatory `FROM ANCHOR <id>` clause naming the prefill base; missing clause = parse error, not runtime failure.

    id="LAW.CTX.ANCHOR.SUFFIX_PREFILL",

    trigger=Trigger(
        event="memlang.op.commit",           # fires just before any mutating op commits
        match={"op": {"SPLICE", "APPEND", "TRUNCATE", "COMPACT"}},
        phase="pre_commit",                   # veto window; post-commit is too late
        source="memlang.interpreter",

        op.target.stream == ctx.stream
        AND op.target.epoch == ctx.head.epoch
        AND op.target.ordinal >= ctx.last_sealed_anchor.ordinal
        AND verify_hash_chain(ctx.last_sealed_anchor, ctx.head)
        AND kv_pool.pinned(ctx.last_sealed_anchor.kv_pages)
        """,
        bindings={
            "verify_hash_chain": "mag.ctx.anchors.verify_chain",   # O(anchors), blake3 chained
            "kv_pool.pinned":    "mag.mem.kv.pin_refcount>0",
        },
    ),

    action=[
        Effect("kv_pool.pin",   anchor="ctx.last_sealed_anchor", ttl="until_epoch_close"),
        Effect("prefill.run",   start="ctx.last_sealed_anchor.abs_pos_end",
                                end="op.new_tail.abs_pos_end",
                                rope_offset="ctx.last_sealed_anchor.abs_pos_end",
                                budget="cfg.prefill.max_tokens_per_step"),

        Effect("journal.append",record="edit.suffix_prefill", carries=["anchor_id","cum_hash","token_delta"]),

        "G1: no write may touch meta-token ordinal < ctx.last_sealed_anchor.ordinal; "
        "violation => veto op, emit ctx.integrity.violation, page the operator channel.",
        "G2: hash-chain mismatch at any link => veto, roll forward nothing; route to "
        "LAW.CTX.RECOVER.FULL_RECOMPUTE; partial KV writes are forbidden (all-or-nothing per op).",
        "G3: pinned pages are eviction-immune; allocator OOM under pin => fail the op, never evict a pin.",
        "G4: prefill budget overrun => chunk across steps; never truncate mid-span silently; "
        "each chunk ends on a meta-token boundary and journals its resume coord.",
        "G5: every committed edit must leave >=1 SEALED anchor behind it; an epoch ending with "
